g.text: How would you like to set this up?
1. Fresh GPU host — create the login-node VM for me (default)
2. I already have two reachable machines
Gateway host (public IP/hostname users SSH to): cluster.example.edu
Login node hostname or IP: login-node.example.edu
SSH username on the login node (must have sudo) [root]:
Path to an SSH private key for that account [/root/.ssh/id_ed25519]:
install build-essential and verify the CUDA/torch toolchain (deploy/setup-compute-toolch
